post.label: Most Helpful Aspects of AI
post.questionText: What aspects of using AI did you find most helpful in refining your brand concept?
post.answer:
I believe AI has been incredibly helpful in expanding my thinking by considering multiple perspectives and potential untapped audiences. When you have a broad idea, AI can help narrow it down and provide more concrete support. However, since my idea was already well thought-out, I wanted to avoid broad questions. Instead, I focused on asking secondary questions that would lead to more specific and targeted answers, as I had originally intended.

I think that it is also helpful to take breaks - and come-back to AI when you have new perspectives in your idea. If you continue to insert prompts into AI for a consecutive period -that is when answers start to become obsolete.

Therefore, I believe that I knew this fact, and deliberately asked the AI very targeted questions - and re-adjusted it when it gave me questions that were off-track. I think it definitely helped me positively in refining my brand concept.

post.label: Challenges When Using AI
post.questionText: What challenges, if any, did you encounter when using AI to refine your brand ideas?
post.answer:
While AI models like (Chatgpt 4o and Chatgpt-4 Mini) can provide a wide variety of answers, this diversity can sometimes be overwhelming and confusing - especially when responses become saturated or inconsistent. This can make it difficult for users to find clear, specific answers.

For me, the key challenge is personalizing AI prompts to ensure that the responses are more tailored to my needs and context.
